readings.Aries: Leadership is not volume. Today, the quieter approach covers more ground. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with money is your relationship with security. They are not the same thing. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Gemini: Your ability to see multiple sides is being used as an excuse not to pick one. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: The protective instinct you're feeling is accurate. Verify that you're protecting the right thing. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Leo: The dignity you carry is real and sometimes it makes you harder to reach. Lower the threshold slightly. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: Your ability to anticipate problems is saving you from some of them and creating others. Know which. Let this one be easy.
readings.Libra: The position you hold in other people's lives is one of grace. Don't let it become one of function. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Scorpio: The secret you're keeping is protecting someone. Including, in some ways, yourself. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more attached to the journey than to the destination, which is beautiful and occasionally inconvenient. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: Your pragmatism is an asset. There is one area of your life where it is preventing something good. The first instinct was right.
readings.Aquarius: Your vision requires infrastructure. You are good at the vision. The infrastructure needs attention today. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Pisces: Your compassion has no limit and it is currently being used against you by someone who knows this. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
